brief:
The Israeli army closed numerous gates and entry points to towns and cities throughout the West Bank, Ma'an Wire reported, following its announcement of large-scale military exercises in the territory. The closures affected multiple population centers across different regions of the occupied West Bank.

The timing and scope of the access restrictions coincided with the military's stated training operations in the area.
